title: 美国财长强势表态：日元干预协调超预期，韩央行前行长为何意外？
speaker: Ri Chang-yong

segments.en: And of course, I had to ask him about the overnight comments from the U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Besan, who is essentially saying, I am the House now.
segments.zh: 当然，我也问了他关于美国财长贝森特隔夜的表态，他暗示自己现在说了算。

segments.en: When it refers to the Japanese yen and that coordinated effort between the United States and Japanese officials, and essentially, you know, don't bet against the yen and don't bet against him because he is now the House.
segments.zh: 谈及日元时，他强调美日官员的协调行动，暗示不要做空日元，也不要挑战他的权威。

segments.en: And former governor, Ri, said he was surprised by those comments as well.
segments.zh: 李昌镛表示，他对这些言论感到意外。

segments.en: The level of coordination to prop up the yen that has happened between the United States officials and those Japanese officials, guys.
segments.zh: 美日官员联手支撑日元的协调力度，确实超出预期。
